description: Given an employer name (Microsoft, JPMC, Goldman, Salesforce, Disney, ExxonMobil 3:1, J&J 2:1, etc.), returns whether they match donations to 501(c)(3)s + match rate + annual cap + platform URL (Benevity, YourCause, Bright Funds, Cybergrants) with our EIN pre-searched. A match can double or triple a gift. Without an exact match, returns self-serve discovery instructions.
name: lookup_employer_match
title: Employer matching-gift lookup
